svg.text: Two levels: the folders, and the files that carry the logic.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: solar_manager, uart_ports, mux_board, port_leds_hw: the ports and their tasks
battery_maintenance: the writes to a battery (off by default)
mqtt_link, node_control, node_health, node_diag: the broker side
web_server, api_shared, node_store, tls_cert, network, ble_provision, github_update
voltronic, voltronic_pi18, pylontech, ant_bms, poller: the equipment's frames
solar_config, solar_json, soft_uart, mux_group: settings, messages, emulated UART
battery_ops, battery_runner, battery_stage, xmodem: the writes to a battery
auth, web_policy, fw_trust, control_gate, ble_*, secret_seal: the shared base

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
